contract.notes: Machine-readable form of THREAT_MODEL.md. Each row names the attack class, the framework control, and the fixture/test that pins it. A pin is a test that fails if the control is removed.

controls.control: validate the registered client and the exact registered redirect URI (loopback port flexibility only) before any redirect; pre-validation errors never redirect
single-use facade codes via atomic Consume; replay returns invalid_grant and revokes the broker record; upstream state consumed single-use
code_challenge required; code_challenge_method must be exactly S256; absent or plain refused; verifier bound to the code
facade's own upstream client + fresh distinct upstream state + own PKCE verifier; verify upstream RFC 9207 iss on the callback; per-route issuer; single-use state
public clients only; https or loopback redirects; server-assigned ids >= 128 bits, hash-stored; bound to the advertising route; per-route rate limit before work

no unencrypted upstream material stored: the durable upstream refresh token in the broker record, and any upstream material transiently carried in the code record (the encrypted token response), are encrypted only; opaque handle to the client; token response drops id_token; upstream error bodies never forwarded; access token byte-identical passthrough
RFC 8707 resource accepted/canonicalized/required to equal the route resource; audience must exactly equal the route URL; validated before broker mutation and at bearer time
https required; discovery doc issuer must equal the configured upstream issuer before trusting endpoints; cross-origin redirect and non-public host rejected; endpoints pinned to the verified issuer
pin: m2-fixture:discovery-bootstrap (issuer mismatch rejected, non-HTTPS rejected, cross-origin redirect rejected)

controls.control: RS256 only; alg none and HMAC rejected; key type must match RSA signing key; keys cached by kid; unknown kid triggers a bounded cooldown-gated refresh; cache expires; issuer checked before and after verification
pin: m2-fixture:jwks-validator (alg-none rejected, HS256 rejected, unknown-kid triggers one refresh, expired-key refresh, issuer-mismatch rejected)

controls.control: facade-minted single-use upstream state keyed by hash(upstream state); an unminted state is rejected (400, no client redirect); the callback correlates client + client state + redirect_uri + S256 challenge and exchanges the upstream code server-side only; upstream iss verified; the facade code is bound to the client's PKCE verifier at /token
controls.residual: client-side state + PKCE-verifier binding: an attacker code cannot be redeemed without the client's verifier, but a client that ignores its own state cannot detect the swap

controls.control: route-derived PRM and discovery documents carry cache-control: no-store so a route-specific issuer/resource is never cached for another route; family mode may set a bounded public max-age; the facade emits its own route-derived document rather than proxying the upstream's cacheable discovery verbatim
controls.residual: a client or shared cache that ignores no-store is out of framework scope; a family-mode deployment that overrides no-store accepts standard shared-cache staleness

cross_cutting: fail closed on every rejection path
bounded error vocabularies; no upstream error body forwarding
no bearer material, upstream token, or PKCE verifier in logs/metrics/error bodies
